Consent.title: Cookies and measurement
Consent.body: We use our own and Google's cookies to measure how the site is used and whether our advertising works. You can accept, reject, or choose by category.
Consent.necessaryBody: Required for the site to work and to prevent fraud. Always on.
Consent.analyticsBody: Google Analytics. Tells us which pages get used and where people get stuck. Never used for advertising.
Consent.marketingBody: Google Ads. Measures which ads lead to real enquiries, including enhanced conversions.
